title: Roveia sector list
description: A plain white section: a 40px heading over a list of huge, light (80px / 300) sector names, each with a tiny index at its baseline, turning blue on hover. On phones each sector becomes a dark card with a blue 165° corner glow, a square illustration, a light title, a paragraph and client names. Rows fade in as they enter the view.
notes: desktop shows the big list, phones the dark cards (both from the same items)
the phone cards force .dark so they stay dark under a light theme
CSS scroll-driven fade; everything visible without support or with reduced motion
